answers.q1: uv (lockfile uv.lock, Python version in .python-version). Install with: `uv sync --locked --extra all`. CI's test job uses `uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all`, but the pre-commit job uses the command above, and it also installs the dev tools (ruff, mypy, ty).
answers.q2: `uv run bash scripts/run-tests.sh`. It sets PYTHONPATH=./docs_src and runs `pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/`. CI runs `uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh`, which is the same run with coverage.
answers.q4: CI lint runs pre-commit through prek: `uv run prek run --from-ref origin/master --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure`. To run all hooks over the whole repo, use `uv run prek run --all-files`. The individual checks are `uv run ruff check --force-exclude`, `uv run ruff format --force-exclude --check`, `uv run mypy fastapi` and `uv run ty check`. The same checks without prek are in `uv run bash scripts/check-style.sh`, which runs `mypy fastapi`, `ty check`, `ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts` and `ruff format fastapi tests --check`. The prek run also covers typos, zizmor, and the docs and README generation checks.
answers.q5: `uv.lock` is generated by uv, so change it with `uv lock` and don't hand-edit it. `README.md` is generated from `docs/en/docs/index.md` by `uv run ./scripts/docs.py generate-readme`, so edit index.md instead. `docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html` is rendered from `docs/en/data/sponsors.yml` by `docs.py render-banner-sponsors`. `docs/language_names.yml` and the language list are updated by `docs.py update-languages`. The translated docs under `docs/<lang>/` (everything except `docs/en/`) are produced by the translation tooling (`scripts/translate.py`, `translation_fixer.py`) and checked by `docs.py ensure-non-translated`, so they shouldn't be edited by hand. There is no vendored code in the repo.
